name: io.github.montygovernance.montycat-mcp
display_name: Montycat MCP — Shared Memory for AI Agents
description: Shared, persistent memory for AI agents — local-first, live, and searchable by meaning.
long_description: Montycat MCP gives Claude Desktop and other MCP-compatible AI systems one durable memory across conversations. Agents connected to the same Montycat engine can remember preferences, decisions, facts, and structured knowledge; recall relevant context by meaning; and react to each other's updates in real time. Run it locally by default or connect it to a trusted shared engine, with the database and embeddings under your control.

montycat_uri.title: Existing Montycat URI (optional)
montycat_uri.description: Leave blank to let Montycat MCP find or start a local engine. For an existing engine use montycat://user:password@host:port/store.

montycat_tls.title: Use TLS for existing engine
montycat_tls.description: Enable only when the configured Montycat engine presents a trusted TLS certificate.

default_keyspace.title: Default memory keyspace
default_keyspace.description: Memory namespace used when an agent does not select a scope or keyspace.

autostart.title: Local engine startup mode
autostart.description: Use auto for native/Docker setup, or off to require an engine that is already running.
